🍂 AERATION UPDATE — OCTOBER 2ND–4TH! 🍂
We’ll be out core aerating lawns October 2nd through October 4th!

If you’ve been thinking about getting your lawn aerated, now is the time to get on our schedule. Fall aeration helps relieve soil compaction, improves water and nutrient absorption, and gives your lawn’s roots room to breathe and grow stronger. 🌱

Overseeding is also available for an additional cost.

📅 October 2nd–4th

📍 Battlement Mesa • Parachute • Rifle & surrounding areas

Spots are limited, so message, call, or text us to get your lawn added to the schedule!
